integrity: Proof gives unrestricted positive-integer amplifier formulas; finite verifiers test base cases and three sample connected graphs. No external independent audit or authorship claim.
scientific_limitations: The full edge-query dimension table is proved only through five ladder columns. The connected amplifiers have unused bridges; no claim for 2-edge-connected or matching-covered graphs. Literature-priority comparison is nonexhaustive, and an inaccessible resonance-graph paper remains a residual risk.
title: First VC–Littlestone gap for domino tilings of two-row ladders and connected planar amplifiers
